describes: packages/plugin/stamp: current mutation APIs, marks, placement and persistence.

cases.name: create-update-and-delete-libraries
cases.covers: Create/update/export/delete canonical libraries, filter kinds, preserve categories, emit facts and isolate a throwing listener.

cases.name: library-writes-that-fail
cases.covers: Missing canonical bytes refuse updates; invalid raster size rejects before an open; required metadata Unsupported and failed saves close with no new library.

cases.name: import-a-registered-library
cases.covers: Registered page keys determine identifiers/labels in page order; title/kind/locale and page metadata survive, hidden registration warns once.

args: [stamp] library 'Goedkeuringen' carries 1 hidden-template or dangling registration(s); they are not stamps and were ignored

cases.name: registry-refusals
cases.covers: Empty/duplicate identifiers and a deliberately malformed absent registry refuse exactly; custom library kind survives successful recovery.

cases.name: marks-become-assets
cases.covers: Ink/free-text marks create typed annotations on scratch pages, export their appearance, then append PDF pages; image and PDF marks use current source bytes.

cases.name: marks-that-are-refused
cases.covers: Conflicting/missing source, malformed colors, empty ink, missing PDF pages and invalid identifiers refuse without adding assets; every scratch/source document closes.

cases.name: an-ink-mark-with-defaults
cases.covers: Ink defaults reach the real engine draft; an empty scratch document closes and rejects without creating a library.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: the scratch document has no page

cases.name: edit-move-and-copy-assets
cases.covers: Asset updates preserve identity and merge metadata; duplicate/move use derived new ids and preserve bytes, previews and metadata; same-library move is an identity read.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: library 'Other' already has a stamp named 'Dup'

cases.name: edits-queued-behind-removals
cases.covers: Asset and library edits queued after their deletions reject not-found when their queue turn arrives.

cases.name: copies-carry-their-metadata
cases.covers: Copies and cross-library moves retain subject/categories/preview and remove the original only after the new asset commits.

cases.name: raster-pages-that-fail
cases.covers: A valid current unchanged flatten status is refused by stamp; required engine flatten Unsupported also closes with no asset, and a later successful raster append recovers.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: flattening the raster into its page failed

cases.name: an-asset-from-annotations
cases.covers: Current extraction resolves the real page and download grant before exporting selected appearances; invalid source/mark, closed document and refused egress cannot add assets.

cases.name: rendered-previews
cases.covers: Preview widths cache independently, failure reports and falls back, empty source page returns null; deleting the asset clears its renders.

args: [stamp] ghost render failed, using the thumbnail:

cases.name: place-without-the-pointer
cases.covers: Programmatic placement uses current annotation operations/resources; per-page failure appears in the batch and successful later placement recovers.

cases.name: the-armed-asset
cases.covers: Armed read follows the shipping annotation stamp tool; tool changes disarm once and permission getters resolve explicit/active/closed documents.

cases.name: can-place-without-a-document
cases.covers: No active document means placement and annotation extraction grants are false.

cases.name: restore-stored-libraries
cases.covers: Stored libraries import file-owned ids; invalid stored bytes warn and are skipped.

args: [stamp] stored library 'junk' could not be restored:

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: importLibrary needs PDF bytes (use createAsset for a raster image)

cases.name: a-store-that-cannot-list
cases.covers: A store list rejection rejects restore unchanged.

cases.name: persist-library-changes
cases.covers: Current persistence saves after each burst, deletes removed libraries, honors exclusions and stops observing after unsubscribe; debounce timers were removed.

cases.name: stop-flushes-a-write-still-pending-behind-another
cases.covers: Current unsubscribe lets already requested work finish; it prevents later library changes from being persisted.

cases.name: persistence-failures-are-reported
cases.covers: Failed store put/delete warn with exact library id; subsequent work remains live.
